title: Paired-anchor global-to-component capital subsidy attribution

research_height.transfer_path: A shared realized-profit ladder transfers scale across components; a causal component-owned ladder tests whether that transfer creates or destroys account profit before any native candidate is opened.

central_question: On the complete paired-month selection lifecycle path, does conservatively removing only volume financed by another component's realized stressed profit increase both actual and doubled-cost profit without worsening raw closed-balance drawdown?

why_now.new_data_role: The current Optimization anchor naturally produced a complete 1,428-birth and 1,428-close compounding lifecycle ledger. Unit 075 explicitly lacked a complete compounding lifecycle distribution; this file now exists without Lab reacquisition or observer work.
why_now.optimization_bottleneck: Static weights, global addition-step grids, aggregate caps, drawdown governors, component outcome states, gain reservations, entry strength, protective headroom and the market-state router are closed. The surviving anchor still uses one global daily profit ladder for five economically different components.
why_now.independence: This is not another weight, step, cap, state, router, threshold, lookback, subgroup or admission-priority search. The `$150` ladder and weights remain exact; only ownership of already-realized growth is changed, and the candidate is forbidden to add volume or admit an unobserved opportunity.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one component-local no-add information seed for a separately owned Optimization proxy campaign after a fresh whole-map comparison.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve the shared global ladder and close component-local, book-local and component-specific capital ownership without rescue.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: The exact H4 and router seeds were consumed; uniform signal strengthening and every adjacent router or signal-label rescue are frozen.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: No new causal external-state field is present in the complete anchor ledger.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: The only two entry-delay rows are economically degenerate and Unit 083 already closed adjacent clock rescue.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: No new time-indexed held-position intervention is available; hold, peer-exit, profit-memory and stop neighborhoods remain frozen.

whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Unit 100 closed the router label mismatch with no seed; another label, model or attribution rescue is not opened.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not automatically open a book-local, component-specific, partial-sharing, alternate-step, cap, window, threshold or admission-reuse successor.

anchor_risk_source.role: Pins the original daily multiplier and volume normalization formula only; formal replay reads the Lab-owned CSV and declaration, never campaign source.

frozen_replay.ordering: Preserve physical CSV order after requiring nondecreasing server_time. Use only BIRTH and CLOSE rows; FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT is counted for integrity and has no economic action.
frozen_replay.source_global_day_multiplier: At the first retained event of each server date, 1 + floor(max(0, source cumulative stressed close net) / 150 + 1e-9).
frozen_replay.source_requested_steps: floor(global_day_multiplier * fixed component weight + 0.5). This is the normalized order request before broker fill aggregation.
frozen_replay.source_filled_steps: The lifecycle BIRTH volume is the adopted aggregate fill. It must be a positive exact 0.01-lot step no greater than source_requested_steps. A smaller fill is preserved and disclosed; it is not imputed back to requested volume.
frozen_replay.component_local_day_multiplier: For each component independently at the first retained event of each server date, 1 + floor(max(0, that component's cumulative candidate stressed close net) / 150 + 1e-9).
frozen_replay.candidate_steps: min(source target steps, floor(component_local_day_multiplier * fixed component weight + 0.5)). Candidate steps must be at least one because all fixed active weights are positive.
frozen_replay.candidate_close: Multiply the source lifecycle actual and stressed close net by candidate_steps/source_steps fixed at its BIRTH; update shared candidate balances and only that component's candidate stressed-profit ledger at CLOSE.
frozen_replay.no_add_contract: Never exceed source steps, create a lifecycle, reuse freed risk capacity, alter event order, or change a source entry, stop, exit, direction, symbol or cost.
frozen_replay.raw_closed_drawdown: Maximum percentage peak-to-subsequent-close decline over shared actual and stressed candidate closed balances, starting at $100; report the worse of the two books.
frozen_replay.marginal_removed_value: Source close net minus candidate scaled close net, attributed to the component and frozen epoch. Negative removed value means the removed cross-subsidized slice lost money.

requirements: The exact declared row/event counts, unique BIRTH/CLOSE position identities, five mapped components and nondecreasing event times pass.
Every source birth volume is a positive exact 0.01-lot step no greater than the reconstructed shared `$150` normalized request; request-minus-fill counts and maximum shortfall are disclosed.
Source actual and stressed totals match `5786.63 / 5477.524` within 1e-7 and all numeric fields used by replay are finite.
Every close belongs to exactly one frozen epoch and both source and candidate balances remain positive.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_COMPONENT_LOCAL_NO_ADD_CAPITAL_SUBSIDY_OPTIMIZATION_SEED when integrity, material binding and every economic seed gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.nonconfirmation: VALID_COMPONENT_CAPITAL_SUBSIDY_NONCONFIRMATION_NO_SEED when integrity passes but either material binding or any economic seed gate fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any environment, input-copy, design or implementation defect is a correction state with no economic verdict and no arbitrary retry cap. Metrics and thresholds remain frozen while the defect is corrected.

decision_translation.pass: Retain exactly one later component-local no-add Optimization information seed. It has no native, forward, Lab engineering or Live authority and may open only after another complete macro-map comparison.
decision_translation.nonconfirmation: Preserve the paired anchor's shared global ladder; retain no capital-ownership seed and freeze component-local, book-local, partial-sharing, component-specific, threshold, step, cap and admission-reuse rescues.

exclusions: book-local, partial-sharing, winner-only, component exception or alternate initial capital
another addition step, cap, delay, threshold, state, lookback, epoch, symbol or direction subgroup
newly admitted opportunities, freed-risk reuse, changed priority or preemption
MQL, SET, runtime, compile, Tester, test, validator, broker/account query or Live/Optimization mutation

execution_accounting.engineering_or_design_corrections: unlimited without verdict while preserving the frozen contract

preoutput_design_correction.cause: The first invocation treated the adopted aggregate fill as necessarily equal to the normalized order request. At the first mismatch, the 2025-05-12 Pressure request reconstructed as 0.23 lot while the durable aggregate fill was 0.22 lot. The no-add hypothesis acts on actual filled volume, so the corrected integrity contract preserves any positive filled step at or below the request.
